notes: kb/Work PB5925 (listing step 4a of docs/rearchitecture/DESIGN-listing.md, 2026-11-18). §2023:7.3.18.3 GR2: "The default LISTING directive is '>>LISTING ON'." The conditional-compilation driver holds the LISTING state, which starts ON (ConditionalCompilationProcessor.Run._listingOn), and the listing's one visibility pass starts ON (ListingVisibility.Apply), so every line before the first LISTING OFF is listed; the witness lists the lines before its OFF. The earlier CONFORMS rested on the signed derivation DRV-GR-7.3.18.3-2 (unpopulatable-antecedent: no listing is produced, A.1 item 117); a listing is now produced on request (cobol --listing at 2002, 2014 and 2023), so the antecedent is populated and the derivation is withdrawn.
